title: Media wall with lit shelves

options.name: The design
options.text: A full-width media wall drawn from your plan: a run of shaker cupboards with ten doors and brass knobs along the bottom, an open niche on each side with three shelves and a fluted back, and a moulded frame round a 75 inch TV in the middle, finished with a cornice at the ceiling. A warm LED strip runs along the back of every shelf in the niches. Press Open the doors to see inside the cupboards.

poster.alt: 3D model of a cream media wall with shaker cupboards along the bottom, lit shelves in a niche on each side and a 75 inch TV in a moulded frame

sizes.label: Cupboards
sizes.value: 570 mm high, ten doors 445 to 450 mm wide

sizes.label: Shelf niches
sizes.value: 800 mm wide each, from the cupboard top to 2100 mm

notes: The widths and heights come from your drawing.
The depths are standard sizes to start from: the wall comes out about 320 mm and the cupboards about 450 mm with the doors. They will be checked on site.
The fluted backs and the LED strips at the back of the shelves are shown as you asked; the exact strips and where the power goes will be agreed before anything is made.
The tall glass display cabinet by the kitchen in your picture is not drawn here yet; it can be added.
The TV is only there to show the size; colours on screen are a guide.
